author: Posighdun
body:
There has never been a proper guide for one of these so I thought I'd make one. This will be a step by step guide. If you're having issues setting one up then make a comment and myself, or someone else, will try to help you out.

Note
In order to do this you must have an email address confirmed to your Avicus account. This needs to be the same email address as the Gravatar account.

Step 1: Go to Edit Profile, via your player head, and under your Minecraft skin head hit the drop box and select gravatar. Then hit Save. Once it says your Avatar should be the default one, a blank face user.

Step 2: Head over to https://en.gravatar.com/ and set up an account. Make sure that the account has the same email registered to it as your Avicus account. Then go up to the top right hand corner and hit Add An Image.
 
Step 3: Choose one of the 4 options and upload your image you want as your avatar. Next crop your image and then hit the button that says "Crop and Finish". After that give it a rating, any rating, it really doesn't matter.

Step 4: Make sure the image is selected with the email address. Give the Avicus website a bit of time to register the change, no more than a minute, and you should be all good.
